messages:
Nina: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we nailed the cause (schema rename + ETL backlog). want clear owners + short deadlines so this doesn't recur.
Harper: split infra vs instrumentation?
Rishi: infra: I'll own ETL backlog + restart. instrumentation: Nina or Harper?
Nina: I'll take instrumentation audit. plan: sampling defaults, header propagation, and small backfill where feasible. ETA 3 days.
Harper: I'll add reconciliation job to run hourly and surface top deltas. ETA 2024-12-02.
Rishi: concrete action list: 1) ETL worker restart & healthcheck - Rishi - 2024-11-29 2) Reconcile hourly job + dashboard - Harper - 2024-12-02 3) Instrumentation audit & sampling patch - Nina - 2024-11-30 4) Pre-deploy schema quick-check CI - Riley - 2024-12-05
eng-oncall-bot: scheduled: rolling restart of etl-workers by Rishi on 2024-11-29 02:00 UTC. rollback on >1% error increase.
Nina: quick SQL to mark evidence and guide backfill: ```sql
select trace_id, count(*) as events, sum(case when span_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as missing
from traces where ts > now() - interval '7 days' and service='ingest'
group by trace_id order by missing desc limit 50;
```
Harper: reconcile rule: alert when (abs(raw-agg)/raw)>0.5% AND abs(raw-agg)>2000 for 1h. will implement in dashboard.
Rishi: I'll post logs after restart and monitor for 24h, will open GH issue and link to postmortem.
Nina: setting weekly 20m check-ins for 6 weeks. first sync 2024-12-06. rotating lead: Harper, Rishi, Nina.
Harper: created infra ticket for reconcile job: https://github.com/redwood/platform/issues/3200
Nina: I'll add the audit results to the postmortem doc and tag evidence. ping here if blockers. :white_check_mark:
